review.reason: The hole layout, mapped fairways, water, bunkers, and walking connectors read consistently with the numbered diagram. The putting greens are too saturated and each has a conspicuous contrasting ring that makes the surface look artificial rather than like one natural close-mown green.

issues.detail: The bright lime putting surface is surrounded by a pronounced dark ring. Reduce the saturation and soften the edge transition so the green reads as one continuous natural surface.
The small bright green has a strong circular ring that gives it a bullseye/platform appearance. Use a natural sage/apple-green surface with only a narrow, subtle fringe.
The putting surface is intensely yellow-green and separated from its surroundings by a distinct band. Tone down the color and make the edge transition more natural.
